nodes.label: Deflated Explicit VR LE Transfer Syntax (1.2.840.10008.1.2.1.99)
nodes.rationale: 0.x silently wrote uncompressed bodies under the deflated TSUID — non-conformant files. 1.0 fixes it: declared syntax and bytes agree; conversion to/from deflated is just a meta edit since the body encoding is ELE on both sides, only the stream-level wrapper changes. Inflation is eager because deflate is a stream-level wrapper — no per-element inflate is possible.
